summary: xAI launched Automations in Grok, allowing users to schedule or trigger recurring jobs (scheduled or email-triggered) that Grok runs autonomously and reports back on, available on grok.com and iOS/Android apps.

mechanisms.reason: The feature lets Grok execute delegated tasks on a schedule or trigger without a human initiating each run, shifting some work from human-operated chat sessions to autonomous agent execution.
mechanisms.quote: Today, we're introducing Automations: jobs Grok runs on its own.
